name: Ning Xia Yin Xing Energy Co.,Ltd
summary: Ning Xia Yin Xing Energy Co.,Ltd is a Chinese enterprise primarily focused on generating renewable energy and manufacturing associated equipment. The company manages an impressive array of power assets, including 12 wind farms and 3 photovoltaic power stations, which collectively contribute an approximate installed capacity of 1,466,800 kilowatts. In its manufacturing division, it produces a variety of essential components such as wind turbines, towers, gearboxes, photovoltaic modules, solar cells, solar trackers, and fixed brackets. The firm also extends its expertise to a broad range of services, including consulting for the design, construction, and operation of wind farms; comprehensive maintenance, component replacement, inspection, hoisting, and engineering construction services for both wind and solar facilities; and overhaul services for coal machine equipment, alongside general after-sales support. Founded in 1959, Ning Xia Yin Xing Energy Co.,Ltd is headquartered in Yinchuan, China.
